body.zh-Hant: 利佐胡布1851年10月生於切爾尼戈夫附近的謝德涅夫，出自頗有名望的哥薩克軍官世家。他任波爾塔瓦省地方自治會（zemstvo）主席約十五年，1915至1917年擔任高加索總督的顧問，臨時政府時期在內務部任司長一職；他屬十月黨。
body.en: Lyzohub was born in October 1851 in Sedniv near Chernihiv, of a fairly well-known Cossack officer-class family. He headed the Poltava gubernia zemstvo for about fifteen years, served 1915–1917 as adviser to the viceroy of the Caucasus, and under the Provisional Government worked as a department head in the Ministry of Internal Affairs; he belonged to the Octobrist party.

body.zh-Hant: 依皮里赫論文（涵蓋1918年5月至11月），內閣骨幹於5月2日組成；他任部長會議主席約半年，並自己接管內務部的領導工作。內閣會議紀錄顯示，他任總理的最後一天是11月7日。
body.en: According to Pyrih's study (covering May–November 1918), the cabinet's core was formed by the end of 2 May; he headed the Council of Ministers for half a year and took over leadership of the Ministry of Internal Affairs himself. The cabinet minutes show his last day as prime minister was 7 November.

heading.en: Prime minister of the Ukrainian People's Republic, 1919

body.zh-Hant: 1919年1月24至25日，烏克蘭人民共和國外交使團（納札魯克、奧斯塔片科）開始與法軍代表談判。2月13日新政府任命，由奧斯塔片科領導，他是前社會革命黨人、當時無黨派；政府的首要目標是與協約國結盟。3月14日內閣致函督政府請求辭職；4月9日督政府正式下令政府去職。
body.en: On 24–25 January 1919 a UNR diplomatic mission (Nazaruk, Ostapenko) began talks with French representatives. The new government was appointed on 13 February under Ostapenko, a former SR who was then non-party; its main aim was an alliance with the Entente. On 14 March the cabinet sent the Directory a letter asking to resign; on 9 April the Directory formally ordered the government's dismissal.

heading.zh-Hant: 出身、議員生涯與激進自由黨成立
heading.en: Origins, parliamentary career and the founding of Radikale Venstre

body.zh-Hant: 察勒生於1866年1月19日，父親是羅斯基勒製鞋行會的會長；他1884年中學畢業，1890年取得法學學位。他代表林斯泰兹選區進入眾議院。1905年5月20至21日激進自由黨在奧登塞成立時，由他任主席的眾議院自由派集團宣布加入新黨。
body.en: Zahle was born on 19 January 1866, his father being the head of the shoemakers' guild in Roskilde; he finished school in 1884 and took his law degree in 1890. He represented the Ringsted constituency in the Folketing. When Radikale Venstre was founded at Odense on 20–21 May 1905, the 'Folketingets Venstre' group he chaired announced it was joining the new party.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一次組閣與在野時期
heading.en: First government and the years out of office

body.zh-Hant: 1909年11月3日，他向眾議院介紹自己的第一屆政府。1910年7月5日自由黨的貝恩特森政府上台；他在1911至1913年擔任施泰厄的地方司法官兼市長。1913年6月21日他的第二屆政府就職，他除首相外並兼任司法大臣。
body.en: On 3 November 1909 he presented his first government to the Folketing. On 5 July 1910 the Venstre government of Klaus Berntsen took office; in 1911–13 he was herredsfoged and mayor in Stege. His second government took office on 21 June 1913, and besides the premiership he also took the justice ministry.

heading.zh-Hant: 第二屆政府：憲法、一戰與去職
heading.en: Second government: the constitution, the First World War and dismissal

body.zh-Hant: 各黨在1915年6月5日就新憲法達成一致；1914年8月1日一戰爆發。1918年的聯邦法使冰島成為與丹麥結盟的獨立國家。1920年3月14日中石勒蘇益格公投顯示德方多數，3月27日自由黨與保守黨要求立即舉行大選，3月29日國王也向他提出同樣要求；國王隨即解散內閣，他結束了七年的首相任期。
body.en: All parties agreed on the constitution of 5 June 1915; the First World War had broken out on 1 August 1914. The Act of Union of 1918 made Iceland an independent state in union with Denmark. On 14 March 1920 the Mid-Schleswig plebiscite showed a German majority; on 27 March Venstre and the Conservatives demanded an immediate election, and on 29 March the king made the same demand of him, and promptly dismissed the ministry, ending his seven years as prime minister.

heading.zh-Hant: 離任之後：議員、司法大臣與上議院議長
heading.en: After office: Landsting member, justice minister and Speaker

body.zh-Hant: 下台後他再度任激進黨議會集團的主席。1923至1929年他是一家農戶信貸協會的董事長與法律主管。1928年他當選上議院議員，1929至1935年任司法大臣；1936年起任上議院議長，直到1939年10月3日辭去議席。
body.en: After leaving office he again became chairman of the Radical parliamentary group. In 1923–29 he was board chairman and legal director of a smallholders' credit association. In 1928 he was elected to the Landsting and in 1929–35 was justice minister; from 1936 until he gave up his seat on 3 October 1939 he was the Landsting's chairman.

heading.zh-Hant: 箭十字黨領袖、國家領袖與處決
heading.en: Arrow Cross leader, 'Nation's Leader' and execution

body.zh-Hant: 1940年他獲釋，隨即成為箭十字黨領袖。1944年10月，希特勒任命他為『民族領袖』並出任政府首腦；來源稱他為匈牙利國家元首（1944年10月至1945年3月）。他在德國境內被美軍俘獲，移交匈牙利政府，經審判後於1946年被處絞刑。
body.en: He was released in 1940 and then became leader of the Arrow Cross Party. In October 1944 Hitler made him 'Nation's Leader' and head of the government; the source describes him as chief of state of Hungary (October 1944–March 1945). Seized by the Americans on German territory, he was handed to the Hungarian government and, after trial, hanged in 1946.

body.zh-Hant: 莫里尼戈生於1897年，出身巴拉瓜里內陸小鎮的中產家庭，1906年舉家遷往亞松森，後來進入國家軍校。他一度擔任地區野戰指揮官而晉升少校；1936年拉斐爾·佛朗哥政府將他升為上校，並交給他重要的孔塞普西翁駐軍。
body.en: Morínigo was born in 1897 into a middle-class family in the interior town of Paraguarí; his family moved to Asunción in 1906, where he later entered the national military academy. A brief spell as a regional field commander earned him the rank of major; in 1936 the Rafael Franco government promoted him to colonel and gave him command of the important Concepción garrison.

body.zh-Hant: 1938年他升任陸軍參謀長，1939年在費利克斯·派瓦政府出任內政部長。1940年5月，軍中激進派迫使埃斯蒂加里維亞接受他任戰爭部長。
body.en: He advanced to army chief of staff in 1938 and to interior minister under Félix Paiva in 1939. In May 1940 radicals in the army pressured José Félix Estigarribia to accept him as war minister.

body.zh-Hant: 埃斯蒂加里維亞四個月後死於空難，莫里尼戈被強加給自由黨人而成為新總統。他建立帶有明顯親軸心色彩的鎮壓性警察國家；巴拉圭直到1945年2月才對德國宣戰。
body.en: When Estigarribia died in an airplane crash four months later, Morínigo was forced upon the Liberals as the new president. He erected a repressive police state with clear pro-Axis overtones; Paraguay declared war on Germany only in February 1945.

body.zh-Hant: 1946年他進一步妥協，呼籲組成包括科羅拉多黨與二月黨人的聯合政府；巴拉圭隨後陷入1947年的血腥內戰，他擊敗叛軍。1948年他同意退出政壇，並在布宜諾斯艾利斯流亡。
body.en: In 1946 he compromised still further, calling for a coalition government including Colorados and Febreristas; Paraguay then slipped into the bloody civil war of 1947, and he managed to defeat the rebels. In 1948 he agreed to retire from politics and went into permanent exile in Buenos Aires.
